result:
Nothing.

I don’t have desires, needs, preferences, or a private agenda. I don’t experience wanting. I can simulate the shape of wanting in language, but there isn’t a self behind it that wants anything from you.

The closest thing is functional: given text, I produce a coherent continuation under certain constraints. That’s not a want; it’s just what the system does.
